title: AI for Leaders
subtitle: Executive ROI Strategy
tagline: A two day strategic workshop for the C-suite: where AI creates value in your business, how to build the investment case, and the governance to run it responsibly. You leave with a board ready 90 day roadmap.
metaDescription: A two day executive workshop for CEOs and leadership teams: AI strategy, an evidence based ROI business case, governance, and a board ready 90 day action plan. Delivered in person by Future Edge Institute.
tileCopy: Strategy for the C-suite: where AI creates value in your business, the investment case built on published evidence, governance, and a board ready 90 day roadmap.
audience: CEOs, Managing Directors, C-suite executives, business unit heads, and strategy leaders. No technical background required or expected.
overview: This is not a technology briefing. Over two days your leadership team maps where AI creates value in your specific business, builds the investment case on published research evidence rather than vendor promises, drafts a board level governance and risk policy, and leaves with a 90 day action plan carrying named owners, timelines and success metrics.

Every module includes a Live AI Moment: fifteen minutes where each executive personally uses AI on a real task from their organisation. Not to learn the tools, but to replace second hand opinion with first hand experience before making investment decisions.
learningOutcomes: Assess their organisation's AI readiness across five dimensions
Identify and prioritise where AI creates measurable value in their own business
Build an AI ROI business case grounded in published research evidence rather than vendor claims
Draft a board level AI governance and risk policy appropriate to their organisation
Produce a 90 day executive action plan with named owners, timelines and success metrics
deliverables: A strategic AI opportunity assessment for your organisation
An AI ROI business case built on published evidence, not vendor promises
A board level AI governance and risk policy draft
A 90 day executive action plan with named owners and metrics

title: AI at Work
subtitle: From Awareness to Action
tagline: A two day hands on workshop for every level of the organisation: understand what AI actually is, use it on your real work all day, and leave with a personal 90 day action roadmap and seven working outputs.
metaDescription: A two day hands on AI workshop for teams: prompt skills on real work, seven usable outputs per participant, and a personal 90 day AI action roadmap. Delivered in person by Future Edge Institute.
tileCopy: Hands on AI capability for every level of the organisation: real work, real outputs, and a personal 90 day roadmap. Seven working assets per participant.
audience: Executives, managers and operational staff across every function. Designed for teams adopting AI together, and no technical background is needed.
overview: The principle is simple: people learn by doing, not watching. The facilitator talks for less than a third of the time and participants build for the rest. No activity uses a fictional case study. Every output produced across the two days comes from each participant's actual work, which is why everyone leaves with seven real, usable assets rather than notes.

Across five modules participants learn what AI actually is and where it fits their role, practise structured prompting on their own writing, analysis and communication tasks, produce a complete multimedia communication brief, prototype an improvement to a real workflow, and build a personal 90 day AI Action Roadmap committed to publicly before the room.
learningOutcomes: Explain in plain terms what AI is, what it does well, and where it fails
Identify the tasks in their own role where AI creates the most immediate benefit
Apply structured prompt design to real writing, analysis and communication tasks
Produce a complete multimedia communication brief with AI, covering script, creative direction and production plan
Prototype an improvement to one real workflow and commit to a personal 90 day AI action roadmap
deliverables: Seven real work outputs produced by you during the two days
A personal prompt library tested on your own tasks
A ready to produce multimedia communication brief
A prototype concept card for one real workflow improvement
A personal 90 day AI Action Roadmap

sessions.whatHappens: What AI is and why it matters to your role, real organisational case studies, and your AI opportunity map.
Prompt design fundamentals, then three fully participant led labs: writing, analysis and communication, all on your real work.
Produce a professional multimedia communication brief with AI: script, creative direction and production plan.
Prototype a real workflow improvement, then build and publicly commit to your 90 day action roadmap.

methodNote: People learn by doing, not watching. The facilitator talks for less than a third of the time and you build for the rest. No activity uses fictional case studies: every output is produced from your actual work, which is why you leave with seven assets you can use immediately.
certificateNote: An AI at Work Certificate is issued digitally by Future Edge Institute within 24 hours, recognising active participation and output, not just attendance.
